connectorSetup.missing: Fill in the connector's host, port, pairing code and every value it requires.
connectorSetup.imageHint: The image your deployment runs. Provisa checks the host against it when it connects.
connectorSetup.hostHint: The host running the image, as Provisa reaches it.
connectorSetup.pairingHint: The line the container printed on its first start, after "pairing code:". It is used once and not kept.
connectorSetup.secretHint: The organization secret to use. Its value is never entered here.
connectorSetup.fixedHint: Set by this connector. It cannot be changed.
